interpretation: All six raw/CLAHE pilot sequences and two earlier full daylight runs pass 17/17 sequence checks.
One original orchard tree0 spur is targeted in every reviewed full run. Tree1 appears in the scene but is not the target.
No task-completion improvement from CLAHE established; one run per condition, no seeds or target diversity.
RTX optical-Z is simulator ground truth; no DA2 or DINO inference was performed.
Post-release tracking loss is retained and compatible with home-directed retreat.
These eight recordings are not the requested Envy/UFO by four-light eight-clip experiment. No MP4 exists in these eight capture directories at audit time.
